guidanceConsulted.query: accessible menubar keyboard navigation roving tabindex
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Follow the APG menubar pattern: roving tabindex, arrow-key traversal, Escape dismissal, aria-disabled over disabled removal from the tab order.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The ARIA bridge implements the full APG contract; fallback menus use role=menu/menuitem with keyboard parity.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP drive verified arrows, Escape, and aria-disabled honouring.

guidanceConsulted.query: declarative menu invoked from button commandfor
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer declarative command/commandfor wiring for button-to-element actions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native path arms real commandfor wiring when the surface exists; otherwise a loudly-labelled scripted fallback runs.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Probe cards render the real commandForElement verdicts.
